test_check_cpu_flags: test check_cpu_flags returns no warnings when all required CPU features are present
test_check_cpu_flags_missing_features: test check_cpu_flags raises a RuntimeWarning when required CPU features like ssse3 are missing
test_check_cpu_flags_unknown_flag: test check_cpu_flags raises a RuntimeError when an unknown feature flag such as HelloWorld is provided
test_check_cpu_flags_skipped_no_flags: test check_cpu_flags skips CPU flag reading when the feature flags string is empty
test_check_cpu_flags_skipped_env_var: test check_cpu_flags skips CPU flag reading when POLARS_SKIP_CPU_CHECK environment variable is set
